description: opensync-rpi pods: OpenSync 6.6.1.0 (opensync-lab's pod build, target RPI_POD) on a Raspberry Pi 4 with an EDUP AX3000M (MediaTek MT7921AU, mt7921u) given to the pod as its 2.4 GHz radio. The fronthaul row is the opensync-lab pod's (the same build and VIF layout). min_hw_mode 11g as there (OFDM-only basic and beacon rates; the MT7921U lists BEACON_RATE_LEGACY). The MT7921U runs one AP per radio, so the profile has no extra slots: of the RDK controller's five-BSS M2 set the agent applies the primary fronthaul BSS and leaves the others out (spec 3.4). No uplink station: the pod's uplink is Ethernet (eth1), which the agent bridges into br-home with uplink.mode ethernet (spec 8.4).
